content.short: Business banking, treasury, corporate cards and international payments.
content.description: Meow is a US business banking platform focused on helping companies earn more on their cash while running everyday finance operations. It offers business accounts with competitive treasury yield on idle balances, corporate cards, bill pay, and international payments, positioning itself for startups and global teams that want their operating cash to work harder without sacrificing access. Meow combines high-yield treasury products with practical banking features like cards and payouts, and has increasingly oriented toward serving modern, technology-driven and AI-native companies. By pairing yield-bearing accounts with spend and payment tools in one dashboard, Meow gives finance teams a way to manage runway, vendors, and reserves while keeping reconciliation and treasury operations in a single place.
content.meta: Meow offers business banking with treasury yield, corporate cards, and payments. Discover Meow and other Neobanks on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
